notes.title: Forgetful Dictator is now free! (Plus big update!)
notes.notes:
Forgetful Dictator is now free on all platforms! This was a little side project I hadn't touched in a while, but I decided to go back, polish it up, and make it free. Thanks everyone for the support! The Steam version will come first, then I'll update the mobile versions soon after.

In addition I've done a major update:
[list]
[*] I've added [b]150 more trivia questions [/b]to the pool.

[*] [b]Difficulty has been reworked[/b], simply because the base game was too hard. Now the default game mode features an autocomplete field for entering countries and capitals. 
Multichoice questions have been reduced down from four options to three. In addition, you can now "Abandon" a country if you're stuck. You won't get points for conquering them, but you'll be able to progress.
The hardcore difficulty mode is what the standard game was before, requiring the player to spell each country and with four multichoice options for questions.

[*] The extra game options, such as Upside-down mode, are now their own game challenges rather than add-ons. 

[*] [b]The scoring system has been overhauled[/b]. The previous version has a system of combos and combo breaking, which was a bit confusing and not in the spirit of the game. 
Now you get your score after the game is finished, with bonuses based on the game mode and remaining resources.

[*] There's been a myriad of smaller changes, bug fixes, and minor additions. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix to 1.2b
notes.notes: This update hopefully fixes a crash and achievement error that was occurring with the Steam version. Please let me know if you are still having trouble with crashes and achievements after this patch.

notes.title: Practice Mode, New Trivia, and More Added in Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Ahead of the Android and iOS release I've squeezed in some nice new features, such as a practice mode and a rework of the Ask the Army system. The price of the game has been dropped by around 33% for most regions.

Features:
-Added a practice mode!
-Ask The Army has been reworked. Instead of a multichoice question, it is now a random 50/50 roll to conquer the country. You can now use Ask the Army on Dino-conquered countries and countries you've already visited

Tweaks:
-Labels have been further improved for readability and neatness
-Country border colours have been changed to make them a little more visible
-The basic white triangle on the UI has been improved with a nice chevron icon
-It is now slightly easier to get medals in the West-Central Asia mode, and slightly harder for Africa (due to size imbalance).
-Added shadows to the flags options in flag mode
-Made it slightly easier to see the required Mission countries when they're highlighted with the "Find" button
-Improved the look of the menu buttons
-Settings menu has be cleaned up somewhat

Trivia:
-20 new general trivia questions have been added
-The Oman Dino question has been changed, the old one was unclear
-Simplified a question about the Dead Sea
-Fixed a question about Laos which had an incorrect follow-up comment

notes.title: New Missions, Faster Games, and More in Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
Features:
-Added three new country groups to conquer in missions: NATO members, Summer Olympic Hosts, and Commonwealth Nations
-Trivia and flag questions no longer interrupt the game by taking control of the camera
-You can now see the names of countries you have already conquered in Countries mode
-Dino countries now have animated outlines so you see them more clearly

Fixes:
-If you have already completed a mission when you select it, you will now be immediately awarded that mission
-Some loading tips have been updated
-Cleaned up the labels in the Balkans and North Africa so they're easier to read
-Fixed a bug where the game could get stuck after completing a mission
-Fixed a bug where highlighted mission countries wouldn't change colour when selected

--

EDIT: Updated to 1.11b for the following fixes:

-Long names such as "Democratic Republic of the Congo" will now fit better on the screen
-Corrected an issue where the capital of Burundi (Gitega) had an extra phantom letter
-Corrected the capital of Tanzania to Dodoma
-Fixed some labels with incorrect orientation in the Right-Side-Up mode

notes.title: Quality of Life Features and More Trivia Added in Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Features
-Added a message that appears to clarify if the currently selected state isn't a country, but a territory or disputed region.
-The loading screen tip will now also appear in the main menu
-Added a few more useful hints and tips

Trivia
-Added 40 Dino Dictator questions for Europe, one for each country. 
-Clarified a question about nuclear weapons in Ukraine

Bugs
